professionalSummary: Hey, I'm Akbar. I'm a developer based in Bandung who loves building things for the web. I've spent the last 5+ years figuring out how to make websites look good and run fast—even when the internet isn't great.

I'm not just about writing code; I care about the whole experience. From the first pixel in the design to the final deploy, I want everything to feel right. I mostly work with React and Next.js, but I'm always picking up new tools to solve whatever problem is in front of me.
At the end of the day, I just want to build cool stuff that works. Whether it's a complex dashboard, an e-commerce site, or a simple landing page, I try to keep it clean, fast, and useful.

areas.name: Full-Stack Web
areas.description: Building full web apps from scratch. Frontend, backend, database—the whole thing.

areas.name: Mobile Apps
areas.description: Making apps for phones. I focus on keeping them smooth and usable offline.

areas.name: Payment Tech
areas.description: Hooking up payments so companies can actually get paid. I know the local gateways inside out.

areas.name: UI/UX Design
areas.description: Designing how it looks and feels. I like things to be simple and easy to use.

education.title: Background
education.details: I studied Computer Science at Telkom University. It gave me a solid foundation in how computers actually work, which helps when debugging weird issues.

location.title: Where I'm At
location.description: Currently based in Bandung, Indonesia. I'm available for remote work or coffee if you're in town.
